description: Expander for MIX8 — a three-band EQ per channel, two sends and two stereo returns

params.text: Gain of that channel's low band, centred on 100Hz, from -36dB through unity to +12dB
Gain of that channel's mid band, centred on 350Hz, from -36dB through unity to +12dB
Gain of that channel's high band, centred on 1000Hz, from -36dB through unity to +12dB
How much of that channel goes to that send, with a response linear in decibels
Takes the signal before the channel's fader, mute and EQ rather than after
Level of that return going into the mixer's final stage, which the master fader and mute then act on

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over how much of that channel goes to that send, attenuated by the knob for it
The left input of that return, mixed straight into the mixer's final stage
The right input of that return; with nothing patched it carries the left input
A 0-10V CV over return A's level, attenuated by that return's level knob

outputs.text: The sum of what all eight channels send to that bus

notes: goes immediately to the right of its MIX8
the returns can be used whether or not the sends are
